resources.string: A newer version of RIFT is ready to install.

If you installed the <font color="textHighlighted">DEB</font> package, you can update the app with your package manager as normal. For example you can run <font color="textHighlighted">sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade</font>.
If you downloaded the <font color="textHighlighted">AppImage</font>, you can either use the AppImageUpdate tool, or just download the new version manually.
If you downloaded the <font color="textHighlighted">.tar.gz</font> package, then you have to redownload it manually.

Updates to the app are managed by Windows, which will update it from time to time. If you want to force update to the new version, you can rerun the downloaded installer manually, or check the Microsoft Store if you installed from there.
Cannot update when ran from the download location. Please move the app to Applications.
Restart the app to apply the latest update.
